race.comment: CASH ME UP (4) scored two runs back at this track then couldn't repeat the dose last start when she led but tired to finish second at this track over 1800m. Certainly cannot be faulted after that last effort. Good enough to put herself back in the winners' stall. LUSTROUS (6) broke last start and finished 35 metres from the winner in fourth over 1800m at this track unfortunate start to this campaign. Big chance if he behaves in this similar assignment. SOSOLUCKY (1) is open to improvement on the debut placing and gets the ace draw NORTHBOUNDBUSINESS (2) broke in the run and finished tailed off on debut last start over 1800m at this track. A nice draw on the front line should ensure a cosy run. May be worth another chance.
